Quarterly Grinder Cleaning Routine:
1. Run 35g of Urnex Grindz all-natural grain pellets through the grinder on a medium setting (around setting 40) to absorb stale coffee oils.
2. Unplug grinder from mains AC wall outlet.
3. Unscrew the upper burr carrier collar by rotating counter-clockwise. Note the zero point position.
4. Use a stiff natural bristle brush and vacuum nozzle to remove loose grounds from the upper and lower 64mm flat burr teeth and sweeping arms.
5. Wipe the stainless threads with a dry microfiber cloth; apply a rice-grain dab of food-grade Molykote 111 silicone grease to the brass threads before reassembly.
6. Re-calibrate burr touch point before running seasoning beans.
